items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We were looking at Bud Powell.

ctx.x: It’s been a while since the last time I sat on a piano with you. You were trying to school me on the evolution of bebop piano. We were looking at Bud Powell. You said, Teddy Wilson, Teddy Weatherford, Billy Kyle, and so on. I did my homework. So you schooled me right, sir. It’s a pleasure to be able to be with you for this interview. If you could – for the record, if you could state your full name, your place of birth, and the date of birth.
The full name is Kenneth Barron, born in 1943 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
